lines.text: معرِفة أبعاد ما بين الكواكب في رَسْمها في الفَلَك وبَيَّنَّا معرفة الأجزاء التي تطلُع وتَغيب وتتوسَّط
lines.plain: معرِفة أبعاد ما بين الكواكب في رَسْمها في الفَلَك وبَيَّنَّا معرفة الأجزاء التي تطلُع وتَغيب وتتوسَّط

lines.text: السماء معها من فلك البروج فيما تقدَّم من هذا الكتاب. وأمّا رُؤْيَة الكواكب التي تُسَمَّى الثابتةَ
lines.plain: السماء معها من فلك البروج فيما تقدَّم من هذا الكتاب. وأمّا رُؤْيَة الكواكب التي تُسَمَّى الثابتةَ

lines.text: واختفاؤُها من قِبَل الشمس فإِنّه اذا عُلِمَ المِقْدار الذي يظهَر منه ويختفِي كلّ صَنْف من أصْناف أقدارها
lines.plain: واختفاؤُها من قِبَل الشمس فإِنّه اذا عُلِمَ المِقْدار الذي يظهَر منه ويختفِي كلّ صَنْف من أصْناف أقدارها

lines.text: السِّتَّة المذكورة في العِظْم كان حِسابك لذلك كما وصَفْنا في الرؤْية. وقد يُقال إِنّ مقدار القَوْس التي
lines.plain: السِّتَّة المذكورة في العِظْم كان حِسابك لذلك كما وصَفْنا في الرؤْية. وقد يُقال إِنّ مقدار القَوْس التي

lines.text: تظهَر وتختفي منها ما كان من الكواكب في العِظْم الاوّل مِثْل الشِّعْرَى اليَمانِيّة والشَّامِيّة وقَلْب الأَسَد{mR:5}
lines.plain: تظهَر وتختفي منها ما كان من الكواكب في العِظْم الاوّل مِثْل الشِّعْرَى اليَمانِيّة والشَّامِيّة وقَلْب الأَسَد

lines.text: والسِّماكَيْن ومُؤَخَّر النَّهْر وما شاكَلَ ذلك في العِظْم فهو خمسةَ عَشَرَ جُزْءًا أعْنِي القَوْسَ التي تظهَر
lines.plain: والسِّماكَيْن ومُؤَخَّر النَّهْر وما شاكَلَ ذلك في العِظْم فهو خمسةَ عَشَرَ جُزْءًا أعْنِي القَوْسَ التي تظهَر

lines.text: منه وتختفي وهذه الأجزاء من أزمان معدِّل النهار وباقي اصنافها التي هي دُونَ هذا العِظْم فعَلَى ترتيب
lines.plain: منه وتختفي وهذه الأجزاء من أزمان معدِّل النهار وباقي اصنافها التي هي دُونَ هذا العِظْم فعَلَى ترتيب

lines.text: العِظْم تكون زيادة القوْس على خمسة عشر جزءًا الى أن ينتهي الى العِظْم الأصْغَر منها الذي في العِظْم
lines.plain: العِظْم تكون زيادة القوْس على خمسة عشر جزءًا الى أن ينتهي الى العِظْم الأصْغَر منها الذي في العِظْم

lines.text: فَيُرَى ويختفي على مقدار بُرْج بالتقريب.{mR:10}
lines.plain: فَيُرَى ويختفي على مقدار بُرْج بالتقريب.

lines.text: في معرفة أَبْعاد الكواكب واقطارها وعظم أجْرامها{n:1} وسَعَة أفْلاكها وذِكْرها مُرْسَلًا{n:2} على نَحْوِ ما
lines.plain: في معرفة أَبْعاد الكواكب واقطارها وعظم أجْرامها وسَعَة أفْلاكها وذِكْرها مُرْسَلًا على نَحْوِ ما

lines.text: قال أمّا بُعْد الشمس والقمر وأقْطارهما وعِظْم أَجْرَامهما فقد بيَّنَّاه على ما جَرَى به القوْل في{mR:15}
lines.plain: قال أمّا بُعْد الشمس والقمر وأقْطارهما وعِظْم أَجْرَامهما فقد بيَّنَّاه على ما جَرَى به القوْل في

lines.text: كتاب المِجِسْطِي وما وقَع لنا بقِيَاس الكُسوفات فلنَبْتَدِئ ذِكْر ما سِوَى ذلك من الأَفْلاك الى فَلَك
lines.plain: كتاب المِجِسْطِي وما وقَع لنا بقِيَاس الكُسوفات فلنَبْتَدِئ ذِكْر ما سِوَى ذلك من الأَفْلاك الى فَلَك

lines.text: زُحَلَ وفلك الكواكب الثابتة على نحو ما تَكَلَّفَه المتأَخِّرْون من الفُضَلاء الحُكَماء قَبْلَ{n:3} بطلميوس فكان
lines.plain: زُحَلَ وفلك الكواكب الثابتة على نحو ما تَكَلَّفَه المتأَخِّرْون من الفُضَلاء الحُكَماء قَبْلَ بطلميوس فكان

lines.text: قوْلهم في ذلك أنّه قد بان أنّ *بُعْد القمر الابعد عن الارض بالمقدار الذي به نِصْف قُطْر الارض{mL:f. 123,r.}
lines.plain: قوْلهم في ذلك أنّه قد بان أنّ *بُعْد القمر الابعد عن الارض بالمقدار الذي به نِصْف قُطْر الارض

lines.text: جُزْء واحد يكون {ov:سد ي} وذلك هو اقرب قُرْب عَطارِدَ وفَلَكَا عُطارد والزُّهَرَة فيما بين ابعد بُعْد القمر{mR:20}
lines.plain: جُزْء واحد يكون سد ي وذلك هو اقرب قُرْب عَطارِدَ وفَلَكَا عُطارد والزُّهَرَة فيما بين ابعد بُعْد القمر

lines.text: الى اقرب قُرْب الشمس وإِنّ نهاية الهَوَاء والنار هي اقرب قُرْب القمر من الارض وذلك اذا كان
lines.plain: الى اقرب قُرْب الشمس وإِنّ نهاية الهَوَاء والنار هي اقرب قُرْب القمر من الارض وذلك اذا كان

lines.text: عن جَنْبَيِ الامْتِلاء أعني على تربيع الشمس الأَوْسَط وقد بان أنّ بُعْده عند ذلك عن الارض يكون
lines.plain: عن جَنْبَيِ الامْتِلاء أعني على تربيع الشمس الأَوْسَط وقد بان أنّ بُعْده عند ذلك عن الارض يكون

notes.text: 1) Cod. اجزايها — 2) Cod. من سلا — 3) Plato melius « post ».

observations: L02, L04, L06, L11, L13, L14, L16, L18, L19: long joins (رُؤْيَـة and الثابتـةَ on L02; مقـدار on L04; فهـو on L06; مـا at the end of L11; مـا and بـه on L13; مـا on L14; قُطْـر on L16; مـن on L18; عنـد on L19) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of والسِّماكَيْن (L06), وذِكْرها (L11) and الحُكَماء (L15).

The page ends chapter 49 and begins chapter 50. It has 19 lines and one line of notes. L01 to L08 run the full measure (113 to 540 pt); L09 ends the chapter: it is short (538.0 to 371.4 pt) and closed by a full stop. After a space stands the heading of chapter 50 on L10, in the larger type, centred (256.9 to 393.0 pt), and after another space its title in two lines: L11 runs the full measure (112.5 to 537.0 pt) and L12 is centred (272.4 to 374.2 pt) and closed by a full stop. L13 to L19 run the full measure (109 to 539 pt); L13, the first line of the chapter, is set in (it begins at 512.1 pt). Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin: they count the lines of the grid of the page (26.7 pt from line to line), with the spaces about the heading and the title: 5 stands beside L05; the tenth line of the grid, under L09, is empty, and the number 10 stands beside it (its foot 371.9 pt down); the two lines of the title stand on the thirteenth and the fourteenth line of the grid; the fifteenth, under the title, is empty, and the number 15 stands beside it (its foot 505.1 pt down); 20 stands beside L17. The folio number «f. 123,r.» stands in the left margin beside L16, where the asterisk stands before بُعْد. Full stops stand on L02 after الكتاب and on L04 after الرؤْية. The rule over the notes is printed in two pieces (111.7 to 148.9 pt and 153.7 to 212.2 pt, 100.5 pt in all, with a gap of 4.8 pt); under it stand three notes in one line set in (137.7 to 398.0 pt), closed by a full stop.
The numeral {ov:سد ي} (64;10) stands on L17, in a smaller type under one bar (19.4 pt); the yā' has its two dots.

The note figures: the figure 1 stands on L11 after أجْرامها; the figure 2 on L11 after مُرْسَلًا; the figure 3 on L15 after قَبْلَ. The notes: for أجْرامها the codex has اجزايها; for مُرْسَلًا the codex has من سلا; for قَبْلَ Plato has, better, «post».

The word العِظْم stands seven times (L04, L05, L06, L07 and three times on L08), and وعِظْم on L13: each time a kasra under the ʿayn (2.9 to 3.6 x 1.8 to 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the top of the stem of the ẓā' (2.2 to 2.5 x 2.2 to 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy, with the dot of the ẓā' beside the stem; no fatha. وعظم in the title (L11) has no signs.

L01: معرِفة: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); معرفة later on the line and in the title has no signs. أبعاد: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) (compare L11). رَسْمها: a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الفَلَك: a fatha over the fā' and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). وبَيَّنَّا: a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt), over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and over the nūn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each). الأجزاء: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and the last hamza on the line; so too on L07 (2.9 x 2.9 pt). تطلُع: a damma over the lām, joined to the top of the letter in the master scan. وتَغيب: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وتتوسَّط: over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt).

L02: تقدَّم: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt). وأمّا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt). رُؤْيَة: a damma over the rā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), over the wāw the hamza with a sukun above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.8 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). تُسَمَّى: a damma over the tā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and over the mīm a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt); the last letter has no dots. الثابتةَ: a fatha over the two dots of the last letter (4.0 x 2.5 pt).

L03: واختفاؤُها: over the wāw the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.8 pt). قِبَل: a kasra under the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). فإِنّه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.3 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt). عُلِمَ: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the lām (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt). المِقْدار: a kasra under the mīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 2.5 pt); مقدار on L04 and on L09 and بالمقدار on L16 have no signs. يظهَر: a fatha over the hā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). ويختفِي: a kasra under the fā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), at the right of the two dots of the yā'; ويختفي on L09 and وتختفي on L05 and on L07 have the two dots only. كلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.2 x 2.5 pt). صَنْف: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 2.9 pt). أصْناف: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a round sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 2.5 pt). أقدارها: the bare hamza over the alif (3.2 x 2.9 pt). اذا: no hamza.

L04: السِّتَّة: a shadda over the sīn (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 2.2 pt), and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). حِسابك: a kasra under the ḥā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). وصَفْنا: a fatha over the ṣād (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الرؤْية: over the wāw the hamza with a sukun above it in one cluster (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and no other sign (compare L02); the full stop follows. يُقال: a damma over the yā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt). إِنّ: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt). القَوْس: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too القَوْسَ on L06, with a fatha over the sīn as well (3.6 x 2.2, 2.5 x 2.9 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); القوْس on L08 has the sukun only (2.5 x 2.5 pt).

L05: تظهَر: one fatha, over the hā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too at the end of L06 (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وتختفي: no signs: the two dots of its first tā' stand high over the khā' (9.0 to 11.1 pt over the baseline); so too on L07. الاوّل: a shadda over the wāw (2.9 x 2.2 pt); no hamza. مِثْل: a kasra under the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the three dots of the thā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الشِّعْرَى: a shadda over the three dots of the shīn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the shīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has no dots. اليَمانِيّة: a fatha over the first yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt), between the two dots of the first yā' and those of the second, and a shadda over the second yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt), without a fatha. والشَّامِيّة: over the shīn, above its three dots, a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt), without a fatha. وقَلْب: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الأَسَد: over the lām-alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a short fatha over the sīn (2.5 x 1.4 pt).

L06: والسِّماكَيْن: a shadda over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a fatha over the long kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt). ومُؤَخَّر: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt), over the wāw the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.0 pt) and over the khā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt). النَّهْر: over the nūn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each) and a round sukun over the hā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). شاكَلَ: a fatha high over the kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt, 13.7 to 15.9 pt over the baseline) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). خمسةَ: a fatha over the two dots of the last letter (3.2 x 1.8 pt); خمسة on L08 has no signs. عَشَرَ: a fatha over the ʿayn, over the shīn and over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2, 3.6 x 1.8 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt); عشر on L08 has no signs. جُزْءًا: a damma over the jīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the zāy (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the hamza on the line with the fathatan above it in one cluster, before the alif; جزءًا on L08 has that cluster only. أعْنِي: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the nūn (2.9 x 2.2 pt), at the right of the two dots of the yā' (compare L19).

L07: أزمان: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt). معدِّل: a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 1.8 pt). اصنافها: no hamza and no signs (compare L03). دُونَ: a damma over the dāl (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a fatha over the nūn (2.9 x 1.8 pt). فعَلَى: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the lām (4.0 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots. ترتيب: no signs.

L08: أن: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt). الأصْغَر: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.2 x 2.9 pt), a round sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy, and a fatha over the ghayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الى (twice): no hamza; the last letter has no dots.

L09: فَيُرَى: a fatha over the fā', above its dot (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt), in both copies; the last letter has no dots. بُرْج: a damma over the bā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy; the dot of the bā' is joined to the foot of the letter, in both copies, as on p. 178. بالتقريب: the full stop follows.

L10 (the heading): no signs. L11 (the title): أَبْعاد: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). واقطارها: no hamza and no signs (compare L13). أجْرامها: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and a round sukun over the jīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt); the figure 1 follows. وسَعَة: a fatha over the sīn and a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.5 pt each). أفْلاكها: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a ring in the second copy. وذِكْرها: a kasra under the dhāl (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the long kāf (2.2 x 2.5 pt). مُرْسَلًا: a damma over the mīm (2.9 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 3.2 pt), a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan over the lām-alif (4.0 x 3.2 pt); the figure 2 follows. نَحْوِ: a fatha over the nūn (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the ḥā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the wāw (3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L12 (the second line of the title): ذَكَرتْه: a fatha over the dhāl (3.6 x 2.2 pt), which stands above the upper stroke of the kāf, a fatha over the kāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the tā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt); no fatha over the rā'. القُدَمَاء: a damma over the qāf, joined to its two dots (4.0 x 6.8 pt together), a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the mīm (4.0 x 2.5 pt); the hamza on the line. والأوائل: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt); the full stop follows.

L13: أمّا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt). بُعْد: a damma over the bā' (2.9 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too on L16 (2.5 x 4.7 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt) and on L17 (2.2 x 4.7 and 2.2 x 2.2 pt), and بُعْده on L19 (2.9 x 5.0 and 2.5 x 2.5 pt). وأقْطارهما: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 2.9 pt). أَجْرَامهما: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the jīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) (compare L11). بيَّنَّاه: over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt) and over the nūn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); no fatha over the bā' (compare L01). جَرَى: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots. القوْل: a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and no fatha; so too قوْلهم on L16 (2.9 x 2.5 pt).

L14: المِجِسْطِي: a short kasra under the mīm (2.5 x 1.8 pt), a short kasra under the jīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), at the left of its dot, a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a ring in the second copy, and a kasra under the ṭā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has its two dots. وقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). بقِيَاس: a kasra under the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). الكُسوفات: a damma over the kāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt). فلنَبْتَدِئ: a fatha over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the dāl (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and the bare hamza over the last letter (3.2 x 3.2 pt), which has no dots; no sukun over it. ذِكْر: a kasra under the dhāl (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the kāf (2.5 x 2.9 pt). سِوَى: a kasra under the sīn (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots. الأَفْلاك: over the lām-alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). فَلَك: a fatha over the fā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the lām, joined to the top of the letter in the master scan and apart from it in the second copy; فلك on L02 and وفلك on L15 have no signs.

L15: زُحَلَ: a damma over the zāy and a fatha over the ḥā', printed joined in one cluster (6.1 x 6.1 pt), as on p. 173, and a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt). نحو: no signs: the nūn stands as a small hook over the ḥā', with its dot (compare L11). تَكَلَّفَه: a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the kāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt), over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a fatha over the fā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). المتأَخِّرْون: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt), a shadda over the khā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt), and over the rā' a round sukun (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a ring in the second copy, where a damma is expected; so in both copies. The word is transcribed as it is printed. الفُضَلاء: a damma over the fā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a fatha over the ḍād (3.6 x 1.8 pt). الحُكَماء: a damma high over the ḥā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt, 13.4 to 18.0 pt over the baseline) and a fatha over the long kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). قَبْلَ: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a short fatha over the lām (2.9 x 1.4 pt); the figure 3 follows. بطلميوس: no signs.

L16: أنّه and أنّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 and 2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt); so too أنّ on L19 (2.5 x 3.2 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). نِصْف: a kasra under the nūn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a sukun over the ṣād, printed as a flat filled oval (2.5 x 2.2 pt), in both copies. قُطْر: a damma over the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الابعد and الارض: no hamza.

L17: جُزْء: a damma over the jīm (2.5 x 4.3 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the zāy (2.9 x 2.9 pt); the hamza on the line. قُرْب: a damma over the qāf (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt); so too twice on L18 (2.5 x 4.7 and 2.5 x 2.2 pt; 2.2 x 4.7 and 2.2 x 2.5 pt). اقرب: no hamza and no signs; so too twice on L18. عَطارِدَ: over the ʿayn stands a fatha (3.6 x 2.2 pt, 8.6 to 10.8 pt over the baseline), a straight slanted stroke in both copies, where the name has a damma (عُطارد, so printed later on the line, with a damma of 2.5 x 4.7 pt); a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 2.2 pt). The word is transcribed as it is printed. وفَلَكَا: a fatha over the fā', over the lām and over the kāf (3.2 x 2.2, 3.6 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt). والزُّهَرَة: over the zāy a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 2.2 x 4.0 pt), a fatha over the hā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). ابعد: no hamza.

L18: وإِنّ: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.3 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt). الهَوَاء: a fatha over the hā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 2.5 pt); the hamza on the line. الى and اذا: no hamza.

L19: جَنْبَيِ: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the yā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt), at the left of its bowl. الامْتِلاء: a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.9 pt), which stands under the left arm of the lām-alif, and a kasra under the tā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt); nothing stands over the alif; the hamza on the line. أعني: the bare hamza over the alif (3.2 x 2.9 pt) and no other sign (compare L06). الأَوْسَط: over the lām-alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt).
